fieldValues.title: WG Third-party ready: cycle close 2026-11-08
fieldValues.chose:
WG Third-party ready: cycle 2026-11-07 11:30 to 2026-11-08 11:30 UTC

1. Decisions for you: four, all unchanged (no new escalation this cycle). Each is a draft decision in the group log.
- Field identity rules (21b6b4b7, srs#236, 9 days): enforce in schema, in a validator, or stop claiming them as standard. Recommendation: audit, then enforce names in the schema and the core reservation in a validator. Action: decide. Urgency: medium.
- Heading-outline continuity (864eaebf, srs#991, 9 days): one rule for every document, or opt-in per Composition. Recommendation: merge srs#991 as drafted, with a downstream audit first. Action: decide. Urgency: medium.
- Is editor UI in the mandate (bc6bc746, srs-web#691, 4 days): the only srs-web ready item is UI work. Recommendation: route it to WG Agent-supported editor. Action: decide. Urgency: low.
- `note delete` default (c7a8e0a2, srs-rust#1497, 11 days): refuse notes with inbound Relations unless `--cascade`. Recommendation: approve. Action: decide. Urgency: low.
Also this cycle, owner-merged: srs#1009 (RFC-054 draft, 16:10 UTC 7 Nov) and srs-rust#1594 (macOS runners to macos-15; the reviewer rejected for the group because it touches release.yml, a gate, and escalated it, which is the boundary working as designed).

2. Decided within mandate: none ratified this cycle. No merged PR named a proposed decision as "decision <id>: assent", so no session was held. The five delegated merges executed existing rulings (see 3).

3. Done: 5 delegated PRs merged (all builder agent:tpr-builder / reviewer agent:tpr-reviewer, verdict approve, gates green, findings none):
- srs-rust#1593 bundled readme written on install (RFC-045 slice 2 of 3), mandate RFC-045 [R3][R6]
- srs-rust#1595 five more definition creates refuse a cross-boundary duplicate id (#1585), mandate 00567bf1 / RFC-038 [R12]
- srs-rust#1596 field definitions persist by typed logical id (#728), mandate 00567bf1 / ADR-041
- srs-rust#1599 Views and Compositions persist by logical id (ADR-041 G3-G5), mandate ADR-041 / 0b1c25b1
- srs-rust#1601 pack picks up the readme (RFC-045 slice 3 of 3, #1164), mandate RFC-045 [R5]
Owner-merge, not counted: srs#1009, srs-rust#1594.

4. Stuck or lost: no needs-input items, no red gates reported by runs. Open group PRs: srs-rust#1574 and #1598 are conflicting (dirty) and need a rebase; srs#1005, srs-rust#1575 and #1588 are behind master with no review since 5-6 Nov. #1574 and #1575 have sat 3 days. Owner-ruled escalations missing from either log: none found.

5. Budget: 5 of 10 delegated merges this cycle; 5 open (all delegated). Pause state: running.
5b. Awaiting ratification: none.

6. Next: 5 issues in the group carry ready + wg:third-party-ready (srs-rust 4: #1496, #1495, #1339, #1164 (done by #1601, should close); #728 (done by #1596, should close); srs 1: #928 (RFC-054 landed as srs#1009, should close); srs-web 1: #691 (waits on escalation bc6bc746); srs-vscode 0). Top 3 in builder order (all P2, oldest first): srs-rust#728, #1164, #1339 (all effectively landed or in progress); the truly open ones are srs-rust#1495 and #1496. Local priorities: none set. Queue running dry: about 2 genuinely ready, budget 10. Needs feeding: the divergence diff and the spec-to-implementation drift list are the sources. Fed by the analyst: wg-analyst run 2026-11-07, filed 1 (a release bug), nominated 4.
6b. Exercises: none open in the group log.

7. What we learned: the reviewer held the line on a gate-touching change (srs-rust#1594), which is the concept holding: the boundary stopped a small change that was otherwise sound, and the owner merged it the same day. Four escalations have now waited 4 to 11 days with no ruling, so the owner's queue, not the group's capacity, limits the work. Measurement I1: 0/0 again (the window handed to `measure` opens at this close, so it says nothing); result 1b82bd49-0b37-4695-a8dc-e0201efe3eca; whether it is useful, noisy or misleading is yours to give in a session. I2 to I4: pending.
fieldValues.rationale: No new escalation was raised: the four items outside the boundary are already open as draft decisions in the group log (21b6b4b7, 864eaebf, bc6bc746, c7a8e0a2). Nothing was ratified because no merged PR carried a decision assent.
fieldValues.figures: merged by group 5/10; open 5 (all delegated); ready issues 5 (about 2 genuinely open); proposed decisions pending 0; escalations waiting 4; paused: no
